description: A painting of several hands passing a round crusty loaf of bread along a chain. A rough hand on the left holds a bundle of wheat stalks and reaches toward the loaf, while a floury hand in a white apron holds the loaf. A hand at the lower left drops a coin toward a dented tin can on a wooden table, next to a burlap sack of flour. A gloved hand at the lower right holds a coin over a wicker basket. The dark background shows a shop interior with a few blurred figures. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.
